consumer.targetLayer: Wayfinder governance, orchestration, typed decision workflows, tracker adapter, public-plan mirror, temporary-spec lifecycle, implementation-ticket handoff, and operational routing/validation

classifications.candidate: Wayfinder map orchestration and one-ticket-per-session planning loop
classifications.notes: ASB owns the adapted orchestration while preserving the donor snapshot and explicit proof ceiling.

classifications.candidate: Research, prototype, grilling, domain-modeling, to-spec, and to-tickets procedures
classifications.notes: Imported as distinct ASB procedures because Wayfinder ticket types are workflow gates, not descriptive categories.

classifications.candidate: Typed ticket/map/spec contracts and HITL/AFK evidence requirements
classifications.notes: Closed schemas and deterministic classes make invalid ticket-type substitutions and inferred HITL completion fail closed.

classifications.candidate: GitHub child-issue, dependency, claim, frontier, resolution, and temporary-spec mechanics
classifications.notes: ASB adapts tracker mechanics behind its own contract; live repository feature/permission availability still requires runtime proof.

classifications.candidate: Map-as-index, ticket-as-primary-decision-source, fog, destination scope, HITL boundaries, chart stop, and temporary-spec doctrine
classifications.notes: The doctrine is now explicit and machine-backed while ASB public plans remain coordination mirrors rather than a second decision store.

classifications.candidate: Pinned immutable donor source snapshots with license
classifications.notes: Exact snapshots are non-executable provenance evidence used to detect AI reinterpretation and stale-reference drift.

classifications.candidate: Donor setup command names, installer layout, exact emoji interview presentation, and project-specific prototype shapes
classifications.notes: Those presentation/setup details are not needed for semantic compatibility and would create unnecessary donor-environment coupling.

capabilitiesDonated: Choose Wayfinder only when the route to a destination is genuinely too ambiguous/large for one bounded session.
Chart a tracker-backed map whose child tickets own exact decision questions and resolutions.
Treat research/prototype/grilling/task labels as workflow gates with explicit AFK/HITL evidence requirements.
Use native blocking and assignee state to expose a visual, concurrency-safe frontier.
Keep coarse in-scope fog separate from precise tickets and destination-level out-of-scope work.
Stop chart mode before non-research ticket resolution and normally resolve only one non-research ticket per session.
Synthesize a temporary spec only after the decision route is clear, then create separate implementation tickets or bounded execution work.
Retain durable decision history after the temporary spec is retired.
proofCeiling: This contribution proves the pinned donor files and license, immutable source snapshots, ASB governance doctrine, skill ownership/routing, closed schemas, deterministic ticket gates/frontier/spec-readiness logic, GitHub tracker command construction, public-plan mirror boundaries, and consumer-side hosted/offline validators. It does not prove live GitHub sub-issue/dependency permissions in a specific repository, hosted-agent judgment quality, actual human HITL answers/verdicts, prototype usefulness, research correctness beyond cited evidence, child-repository adoption, or destination implementation/deployment.
mustNotCopyOrReimplement: Do not treat public-plan tasks as a second copy of Wayfinder decision tickets.
Do not put a full decision answer in both the map/public plan and its decision ticket; the ticket owns the detail.
Do not allow an agent to satisfy prototype or grilling HITL gates with its own recommendation or inferred approval.
Do not turn Wayfinder decision tickets into implementation tracer-bullet tickets; use to-tickets only after the route/spec is clear.
Do not make the temporary spec the durable source of decision rationale; retain ticket history.
Do not edit imported donor snapshots in place or auto-update the donor pin.
Do not make child repositories depend directly on mattpocock/skills; adoption requires an explicit consumer contribution.
